notes: Printed exactly as shown: V'' = [Vf -2/3(Vf -Vd)]T -Vd T2. The double prime is printed as two raised commas; the minus before Vd sits between the bracket term and the second product with no multiplication sign, and T is closed up against the closing bracket.
